title: 1:1 prep - Ethan Zhao (IC) - Feb 25 2026
content:
Meeting prep notes and agenda

Date: 2026-02-25
Time: 10:00am PST
Attendee: Ethan Zhao (IC - serving runtime)
Duration: 30m
Location: Zoom / Slack huddle

Objectives
- Quick sync on current sprint tasks and unblockers
- Review KV cache perf experiment results and next steps
- Discuss oncall experience + blameless postmortem actions
- Career check-in: growth areas, project preferences
- Agree on top 2 priorities for next sprint

Context / background (for me)
- Ethan is mid-senior IC, recently promoted, owns KV cache and batching work. Ran experiment INF-321 (linear) to change eviction policy; perf + cost tradeoffs.
- Last week's PR: serving-runtime#342 landed with batching improvements but introduced flakiness in CI (flake on test shard 7).
- Oncall last week: page related to model routing fallback took ~40m to resolve; SRE follow-ups in INF-498.

Agenda (walkthrough)
1) Quick personal check-in (5m): how are you doing? any bandwidth concerns?
2) Sprint status (5m): what shipped, what is blocked? key tickets: INF-321, INF-498, PR#342
3) KV cache perf (8m): review latest numbers, agreement on rollback vs tune
   - Key metric: p95 latency (tokens/sec), cache hit rate, token cost delta
   - Ask: do you have confidence in rollout thresholds? any missing telemetry?
4) CI flakiness & oncall (6m): root cause, mitigation plan, owner of follow-ups
5) Career / growth (5m): interests in leading a small infra project, mentoring opportunities
6) Wrap & action items (1m)

Questions to ask Ethan
- What's the biggest risk you see for KV cache rollout? (data, perf regressions, memory)
- Are we missing any tests or monitoring that would make you more comfortable? (e2e sims, longer load tests)
- How was the oncall handoff? anything we should change for rotations?
- Do you want to lead a small project to improve test infra (reduce CI flakes)?

Notes to self
- Validate the gating metric: ensure both latency and token cost considered
- Offer to block a week of my calendar for pairing on rollout verification if needed
- Consider assigning a junior engineer to own the flaky test investigation with Ethan as mentor

Potential follow-ups (post-meeting)
- If Ethan wants to roll forward, approve canary plan: 5%->25%->100% with guardrails (rollback triggers)
- Assign INF-498 to SRE + Ethan for routing fallback postmortem
- Create a short PR checklist to reduce CI flakes; propose in eng-sre channel

Action items (explicit)
- Ethan: run extended load test for KV policy variant B and share results (due 2026-03-03)
- Olivia (me): block pairing session for rollout verification (2h) and share calendar invite (due 2026-02-27)
- Ethan + SRE: draft postmortem for routing fallback incident INF-498 (due 2026-03-02)
- Olivia: propose small mentorship plan and offer to sponsor onboarding of junior owner for CI flakes (due 2026-03-05)

Quick links
- Linear: INF-321, INF-498
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/342
- Confluence playbook: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/INF/KV+Cache+Perf
- Slack thread: #eng-serving-runtime (thread: t1CKj9r8)

Trash / scratch (ideas)
- If cache hit rate < 60% maybe fall back to async prefetching experiment
- Consider metric: cost-per-1000-tokens normalized by model size

End of doc
